configurePresets.name: uwp-x64
configurePresets.description: Configures Eden's core stack (common/core/dynarmic/video_core/...) for the Xbox UWP/WindowsStore (AppContainer) target. Desktop frontends are off; dynarmic builds in its W^X + Virtual*FromApp mode. Renders with Direct3D 12 (the Null renderer without a window); Vulkan, OpenGL and ReShade are left out. IMPORTANT: run from a 'vcvarsall.bat x64 uwp' shell so cl/link target the Store CRT (see docs/xbox/uwp_build.md). The Ninja generator avoids the VS-instance lookup the VS generator requires.

configurePresets.name: uwp-x64-nolto
configurePresets.displayName: Xbox UWP / AppContainer (x64, no LTO, fast iteration)
configurePresets.description: Same build as uwp-x64 without whole-program optimization, in its own binary dir: links far faster for fixes that need many builds, such as graphics corrections. Runs slower, so never use it for performance measurements or releases.

buildPresets.name: uwp-x64
buildPresets.description: Build the Eden core stack for UWP. Add --target <core|dynarmic|common|video_core> to scope.

buildPresets.name: uwp-x64-nolto
buildPresets.description: Build without LTO for fast iteration. Add --target jadyx.
